goal: Identify and document specific skill gaps through targeted self-assessment activities and external benchmarks.

steps.task: List all key skills required for your role or desired career path based on job descriptions and industry standards.
Rate your own proficiency for each skill on a scale (e.g., 1-5) to identify initial gaps.
Take online self-assessment tests relevant to your field (e.g., LinkedIn Skill Assessments, Coursera quizzes).
Compare your self-ratings and test results against objective benchmarks such as certification requirements or expert proficiency levels.
Document the identified skill gaps in a structured format (e.g., spreadsheet) with the gap severity and priority.

goal: Using the documented skill gaps, design a personalized learning and development plan that prioritizes addressing the most critical gaps with specific resources and timelines.

steps.task: Review documented skill gaps and identify the most critical ones based on impact and urgency.
Prioritize the top 3-5 skill gaps that need immediate attention.
Identify specific resources (courses, books, mentors, workshops) for each prioritized gap.
Set realistic timelines with milestones for addressing each gap.
Create a personalized learning plan document with resources and timelines.

goal: Implement the personalized learning plan by scheduling regular study sessions and tracking progress against milestones.

steps.task: Define specific learning objectives and milestones
Assess current knowledge and skill gaps
Create a schedule for regular study sessions (e.g., weekly or daily)
Set up a tracking system (e.g., spreadsheet, app) to monitor progress
Identify resources needed (books, courses, tools) and acquire them
Begin study sessions according to schedule
Log completed sessions and progress toward milestones
Review progress weekly and adjust plan as needed

goal: Establish a feedback loop by seeking constructive input from peers or mentors on your skill improvement progress and adjusting the learning plan accordingly.

steps.task: Identify a list of peers or mentors who can provide constructive feedback on your skill improvement.
Prepare specific questions about your progress and areas for improvement.
Reach out to each peer/mentor and schedule a feedback session.
Conduct the feedback sessions, actively listening and taking notes.
Analyze the collected feedback to identify common themes and actionable insights.
Adjust your learning plan based on the feedback received.
Set a recurring schedule for feedback loops to ensure continuous improvement.

goal: Create a shared digital portfolio to showcase skill improvements and collect feedback from a broader professional network.

steps.task: Research digital portfolio platforms (e.g., LinkedIn, GitHub, personal website builders) and choose one that fits your needs.
Define the scope of your portfolio: decide which skills and improvements to showcase.
Gather and organize evidence of skill improvements (e.g., certificates, projects, writing samples, testimonials).
Create a structure for the portfolio: sections for bio, skills, projects, achievements, and feedback form.
Build or populate the portfolio on the chosen platform with the collected evidence.
Set up a feedback collection mechanism (e.g., embedded form, comment section, or link to survey).
Share the portfolio with your professional network via email, social media, and relevant communities.
Monitor feedback and update the portfolio periodically based on inputs and new achievements.

goal: Conduct a root cause analysis of the skill gaps identified to determine whether they stem from lack of knowledge, practice, or feedback, and then adjust the learning strategies accordingly.

steps.task: Identify specific skill gaps by analyzing performance data and stakeholder input.
Categorize each skill gap as due to lack of knowledge, practice, or feedback.
Collect qualitative feedback from learners and managers to validate root causes.
Determine which learning strategies are misaligned with the root causes.
Design adjusted learning strategies addressing the specific root causes.
Implement the new strategies and communicate changes to stakeholders.
Monitor outcomes and iterate based on new data.

Identify skills and competences from feedback text using keyword extraction or NLP models.
Define a mapping from extracted skills to learning plan topics and priority levels.
Implement a feedback collector that polls different sources (API for peer reviews, mentor forms, portfolio comments) and normalizes data.
Build an aggregation module that computes a weighted sentiment score per skill based on source reliability and recency.
Develop a rule-based or simple ML model to map sentiment and skill gap impact to priority adjustments.
Integrate priority adjustments into the learning plan system (e.g., update a database or a config file).
Test the system with sample feedback and validate priority changes.

goal: Analyze aggregated feedback data from multiple sources to identify patterns in skill development and automatically refine learning plan priorities using sentiment analysis and trend detection.

steps.task: Aggregate feedback data from multiple sources (e.g., surveys, reviews, assessments) into a unified dataset.

Apply sentiment analysis to classify feedback as positive, negative, or neutral per skill area.
Perform trend detection to identify patterns in skill development over time.
Correlate sentiment trends with current learning plan priorities to identify gaps or overemphasis.
Automatically refine learning plan priorities based on identified patterns and sentiment insights.
